<thought>We need to determine how many methyl (CH₃) groups are present in the unknown molecule. The only way to get structural information is to retrieve its NMR data. I will first request the 13C NMR spectrum, which typically shows signals for methyl carbons around 10–30 ppm. From that we can count the number of distinct methyl carbon signals, which corresponds to the number of CH₃ groups.</thought>
